reason: I'm two waiters short and the last thing I need is my remaining staff fighting me over a new way of closing bills. Even free for three months, rolling out QR payments means training people and changing how tips work, and I don't have the bandwidth right now.
objection: If guests pay on their phone, my waiters will worry their tips disappear, and I can't afford to lose anyone else over it. I also don't want another system next to my POS.
would_change_my_mind: A clear tip option on the payment screen that goes straight to the waiter, plus proof from another Tbilisi restaurant that staff accepted it and it saved them time.
